function missing<T extends { value: number }>(): keyof T { return "wrong"; }
function unbounded<T extends any>(): keyof T { return "wrong"; }
function recursive<T extends { [K in keyof T]: string }>(): keyof T { return "wrong"; }
function only<T extends { left: 1, shared: 4 } | { right: 2, shared: 4 }>(): keyof T { return "left"; }
function variadic<T extends unknown[]>(): keyof [string, ...T] { return "7"; }
